Membership.Description: A monthly subscription program created for Lazy Dog lovers offering various perks for $5/month.

Cancellation.Process: Email help@ldcampfireclub.com at least 5 days before the next charge

HomeRestaurant.Purpose: Allows members to select a preferred location
HomeRestaurant.Redemption: Benefits can be redeemed at any participating Lazy Dog Campfire Club location

FreeAppetizerOrDessert.Description: New members receive a free appetizer or dessert on their first dine-in visit

MonthlyOffers.Description: Choose between a free TV dinner to take home, appetizer, or dessert each month (up to $15+ value)

PrioritySeating.Description: Add name to Priority Seating list when there's a wait
PrioritySeating.Redemption: Inform host and provide phone number

PriorityAccess.Description: Early access to events, contests, and new menus (First access to book)

SurprisePerks.Description: Additional perks and surprises offered randomly

BirthdayReward.Description: Special reward for members on their birthday

Limitations.BenefitRollOver: Unused benefits do not roll over; they expire after 30 days
Limitations.CombiningOffers: Multiple offers cannot be combined on one check
